title: [Showcase] We're building a tool to turn image into Game-Ready Sprites. Need beta testers! (Free tokens inside)
author: Prestigious-List2632
selftext:
I just launched an early alpha of an AI-powered Asset Generation site for game developers and creators.

The platform can generate 2D game assets, images, sounds, and simple visual elements using AI, all in one place.  
This is still an early test version, so I’m mainly looking for feedback, bug reports, and real usage insights.

To help early users get started, I’m giving out free credits through a coupon for Reddit users.

**Coupon Code: WELCOME200**

If you find bugs or issues and report them, I’ll also provide additional credits as a small thank-you.

My goal right now isn’t sales — it’s to learn how people actually use the product and improve the quality fast.

If you're a:

* Game developer
* Indie creator
* AI enthusiast

I’d really appreciate you trying it and sharing honest feedback.

https://preview.redd.it/14gy93ixl3ig1.png?width=2882&format=png&auto=webp&s=ad35cef8e5aa9f8b9ae702e1324631cde037b92b

Site: [https://telube.com/](https://telube.com/)

Thanks for taking a look 🙏
